question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Given the matrix $A$ above, evaluate the bilinear form $B(x,y)={x}^{T}\,Ay$ when $x=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 5\end{aligned}]$ and $y=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4\end{aligned}].$

current_example.problem:
Consider the the bilinear form $B(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}),$ given by 

$$
B(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})= 2 x_1y_2 - x_2y_2 +3 x_2y_3-x_3y_1
$$

current_example.worked_solution:
We are given that 

$\qquad$ ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14124253/assets/6cb19a28ae24d703c6bc04aa8afb11a75bec7a2b1802e5e6cd34e7441d3cea43.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14124253/assets/dba981d80601d2463bf21359bb96370d0dff29fcc0484d9739c0c52ad61067cd.svg) 

Substituting these into the bilinear expression, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+3{x}_{2}{y}_{3}-{x}_{3}{y}_{1} \\  & =2\cdot 1\cdot 2-1\cdot 2+3\cdot 1\cdot 1-(-1)\cdot (-2) \\  & =4-2+3-2 \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
